for compliant control.

tested scooping with objects of different sizes.
Surface-assisted scooping and lifting; motion comparison with and without
compliant control.

06  /  HUMAN CORRECTIONS / RESIDUAL LEARNING
Learning from Human Corrections
Online residual learning from physical human corrections during insertion.
Learning from physical corrections
Residual model on a frozen base policy; online
learning and execution loop using physical
correction data.
1.
Added a residual head predicting Δpose to the
base policy output.
2.
Used human-corrected robot poses as supervised
targets.
3.
Implemented asynchronous actor-learner updates
and output limits; evaluated insertion.
Base + residual box-insertion evaluation at the original target and a target shifted 3
cm backward.
